subject: planner: index join probe index used cols ndv shouldn't care about range col & add some consideration when two index ndv are quite close (#65534)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff with planner focus. The only production change is in `pkg/planner/core/index_join_path.go`: NDV used for probe-index heuristics now ignores a trailing range column (`lastColIsRange` → `eqUsedColsLen`), and incomparable index-join paths add a new tie-break sequence (`isNDVClose` → `usedColsLen` → join-key coverage). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, or session/protocol risks found; changes affect plan choice heuristics only. Later `upstream/master` history touching this file (ea9094d442) removes a deprecated index-join build helper but does not modify these heuristics.
